result.title: Validation-Guided Prompt Selection for Differential Morphing Attack Detection
result.summary: Differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) compares a trusted live capture with a document image that may contain a facial morph. We investigate whether labelled validation data can improve a frozen-parameter vision-language evaluator through prompt selection rather than model fine-tuning. Version~1 generates 50 candidate prompts and selects the top-ranked instruction using a security-oriented loss that prioritises missed morph attacks (MACER) while accounting for bona fide classification errors (BSCER), response failures, parse failures, and decision inconsistency. Version~2 recursively revises prompts using aggregate validation feedback. On a subject-disjoint test set of 160 pairs spanning LMA, MIPGAN-2, and PIPE, the selected Version~1 prompt achieves a (19.17\%) morph attack classification error rate (MACER), with (0.00\%) observed bona fide sample classification error rate (BSCER), compared with (70.00\%) MACER for a controlled manual prompt. The paired (50.83) percentage-point difference has a (95\%) subject-bootstrap interval of ([43.33,58.33]). Recursive revision does not surpass the best Generation~0 validation loss; the reported revised descendant obtains (31.67\%) test MACER. All 23 attacks missed by Version~1 are landmark-based (LMA) morphs. Overall, the results show that prompt formulation can substantially influence frozen-parameter VLM-based D-MAD performance, while also highlighting the challenge of recursive prompt refinement under a compact 10-subject validation setting.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在参数冻结的 VLM 上做差分人脸变形攻击检测（D-MAD），不改模型权重，而是在标注验证集上生成 50 个候选提示并用含漏检、误报、解析失败和判定不一致等项的安全导向损失挑选，以及尝试用聚合验证反馈递归修订提示，在 160 对测试样本上比较其错误率。
AI.relevance_reason: 可供核查的线索是「冻结模型 + 用验证集聚合反馈在候选提示间做搜索与选择」，这可能类比 LVR 中不更新参数、以验证信号筛选候选推理轨迹或 latent 假设的选择与验证机制；但论文本身无 latent 状态与视觉证据推理，迁移空间有限。
